issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'Israel' (יִשְׂרָאֵל) as the speaker, but the Vietnamese renders 'Ích-thi-ên' (Issachar), a different name. This is a name swap.

The Hebrew 'רַב' (rav) here means 'enough' or 'it is enough' (i.e., 'It is enough; Joseph my son is still alive'), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Thật là tốt lành' ('Truly it is good'), which changes the meaning.
